name: business-audit-forensics
description: Examine a business's financial records and investigate them forensically. Runs two postures: internal audit (reconcile, test controls, vouch entries, verify assets, questions for the bookkeeper) and forensic investigation (chain of custody, fund tracing, competing-hypothesis testing, loss quantification, expert-report discipline). Built around one rule: a pattern is a hypothesis, not a finding, until it is corroborated against a source document outside the ledger. Includes scripts for an evidence register with tamper detection, two-directional reconciliation, prior-year roll-forward, and an exception battery where every test carries a positive control.
author: Dina Farhat
